recipe.name: can-i (FastAPI + Textual)
bootstrap: cd /data/can-i && uv venv .venv --python 3.13 && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e '.[dev]'
test: cd /data/can-i && env -u PYTHONPATH -u VIRTUAL_ENV .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q
recipe.start: cd /data/can-i && env -u PYTHONPATH -u VIRTUAL_ENV .venv/bin/python -m cani web --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8377
evidence: Manual manifest: auto-detection assumed bare pytest and uvicorn main:app
